text:
Arjun (marketing): Quick thread need a sharp iteration of the battlecard vs cloud AI platforms / LLM APIs / infra vendors ahead of next week's webinar. Focus: one-liner takedowns, 2 econ bullets, and an inbound-routing play.
Keisha (field): Agreed. Let's be specific: 1) predictable throughput (peak tokens/sec), 2) unit cost per rendered token with/without caching. Avoid vague words like 'faster' w/o numbers.
Leo (research): I can supply numbers. Current hosted p95 is ~120ms unbatched, ~40ms with 16-request batching; dedicated steady-state throughput ~3k tokens/s per GPU. Will export a tiny table.
Priya (product): For infra vendors we need a short ops counter: 'You can buy GPUs; you still need serving, caching, rollouts, and tracing.' One sentence.
deploy-bot: Reminder: change logs for battlecard should include last-validated-bench ts=1768800000 and owner=research.
Keisha (field): For competitor claims: when they say "build your own for cheaper" we should say "Total dev + infra + maintenance > 9 months and X FTEs." Keep that as an objection handler.
Arjun (marketing): Good. Draft 3 soundbites: 1) "Serving-first economics: predictable throughput, tools to control unit cost." 2) "Same API, everywhere: hosted -> dedicated -> private." 3) "If you care about uptime under burst, don't rely on best-effort endpoints." Keep them short.
Leo (research): I'll attach CSVs: p50/p95, batched vs unbatched, quantized vs fp16. Also add a simple failover microbenchmark where we throttle primary region.
Priya (product): In the battlecard section for "Rebut: "we're simpler"" use: "Redwood: simple API + ops primitives. DIY: catch-up on rollout tooling, KV caching, and tracing."
Keisha (field): Inbound routing play: map leads by tokens/month and compliance need. Rough mapping: 
- Explore: <10k tokens -> trial SDR
- Growth: 10k-100k -> SDR + solutions intro
- Enterprise: >100k or compliance -> AE + SE
Put a one-liner for each.
Arjun (marketing): Perfect. Final ask: can we get a 2-slide appendix with 
- microbench chart (Leo)
- inbound routing table (Keisha)
Slides by Tue EOD so I can bake into webinar deck.
Priya (product): I'll proof the messaging for accuracy and legal.
Keisha (field): I'll draft demo script for live failover + cost dashboard (30s).
Leo (research): Exporting charts now; will ping when done.
Arjun (marketing): Thanks team. We'll reconvene Tue 9:30 for a quick review. :sparkles:
